protocol.failure: Seven wrist-box witnesses miss CAD by 8.637–23.515 mm; corrected saved pose has zero closed wrist witnesses.
protocol.hypothesis: Selecting a feasible physical brace strategy reduces the frozen reach/support/motion score by at least 10% versus fixed elbow_forearm on the reserved target.
protocol.target_basis: 1.06 m is the preceding measured condition; 0.98 m is a previously studied target with different historical mode preference. Neither is a hardware uncertainty range.
protocol.score: Reject when hold reach RMS >30 mm, CAD-valid closed selected-body support minimum <20 N, lost loaded floor contact >20 ms in hold, or any sampled hold predicted cone force violation >1 N / moment violation >0.1 N m. Otherwise score = reach RMS/30 mm + 20 N/minimum support + integral(sum(joint_speed^2) dt)/10 rad^2/s. Lower is better. Ties retain baseline.
protocol.thresholds: Task-screen assumptions; no measured hardware loading or speed limits. Hold is 4–6 s. Motion integral is whole episode.
protocol.selection_rule: Choose on 1.06 m only, freeze winner before running 0.98 m. If no candidate passes, reject selection and report raw tradeoffs; never credit a rejected force.
protocol.strategy_rule: Try forearm_wrist design against fixed elbow_forearm. If either requested wrist/forearm body lacks a closed CAD-valid design witness, use elbow-only as alternate. No tuning from reserved results.
protocol.surface_region: Same-body collision boundary within 0.5 mm of CAD and 25 degrees of a closest outward triangle normal; individual point forces, no finite pad area or torsional capacity.
protocol.geometry: Named wrist box replaced in memory by existing CAD convex collision mesh, both planner geometry queries and plants.
protocol.observation: default_sense(seed=17); only archived design q_star seeds offline geometry IK; rollout truth used for scoring/rendering.
